verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or account-offboarding capability: no bulk export of reviews, learned preferences, custom rules, or patterns in open formats. Nearby items do not qualify. The repo-stored greptile.json config, MCP/CLI access to individual PR comments, review comments living on GitHub/GitLab, and self-hosted logs on customer servers are adjacent features, developer building blocks, or host-platform storage. None of them is a product-level export-and-leave feature.
